currentParagraphText: Sylphie stared hopefully down at Jake, and Dina also looked like she would like him to come, but Jake sighed and shook his head. “Maybe at some point for a small adventure, but not here in the beginning. I’m strongest when I’m alone, and my Path revolves around sneak attacks and facing down powerful foes on my lonesome.”
